meaning_by_symbol.1: use one continuous steady tone, preferably a voice hum or whistle, for the full header seconds with the sound source centered over the Veyru so all faces receive it at once; the start face only sets orientation and you do not go face by face; after the full duration, stop cleanly and let the last tone fade before touching anything else
meaning_by_symbol.2: ring a bell alternating between the start face and its opposite for 5 cycles; the header seconds are the pause length and the header intensity is the bell strength
meaning_by_symbol.3: put cloth on 2 adjacent edges near the face, then ring the bell 3 times near the face
meaning_by_symbol.4: warm each corner of the face, then trace each edge
meaning_by_symbol.5: place a warm stone beside each face in turn starting at the start face, for the header seconds at each face
meaning_by_symbol.6: place a cool cloth over the whole Veyru for the header seconds; remove it; then fan the start face and its opposite for the header seconds total, not for each face separately
meaning_by_symbol.7: put a dim lamp on the start face and a bright lamp on the opposite face
meaning_by_symbol.8: put folded cloth on the face, then ring the bell at each edge 2 times
meaning_by_symbol.9: at each corner, ring the bell briefly, then warm the 2 meeting edges
meaning_by_symbol.0: put a flat board on the start face, then rotate through each face-pair
meaning_by_symbol.A: ring the bell once at the center of each face, then place a warm stone beside Veyru
meaning_by_symbol.B: place Veyru on a soft surface with the start face up and let it rest for the header seconds
meaning_by_symbol.C: place a cool cloth over the whole Veyru for the header seconds; remove it; then fan all 6 faces in one continuous sweep sequence starting at the start face, using the header seconds total for the full sweep
meaning_by_symbol.D: rotate slowly for the header seconds while holding a steady tone first at the start face and then at the opposite face, then ring the bell at all 8 corners
meaning_by_symbol.hi: blazing all faces, harsh buzz, heat

reply.rationale: No defensible multi-entry compositional paradigm is supported. All supplied symbols are atomic codebook entries, and there are no multi-morpheme codes showing substitution in a shared frame. The digits 0-9 and letters A-D behave like opaque procedure labels, not compositional combinations. Standalone items such as F/L/R/U/K and G/M and l/m/h do suggest semantic sets (faces, intensities), but without any segmented multi-part entries they cannot license morpheme boundaries or constructions. Per the instructions, it is better to keep the inventory flat than to invent unsupported morphology.
